title: A Fine-grained Spatiotemporal ECoG Dataset during Speech Perception in Tonal Language
description: Electrocorticography (ECoG) recordings from patients during speech perception in a tonal language (Mandarin), collected at Huashan Hospital. The BIDS version provides the 70-150 Hz Hilbert high-gamma envelope, not raw voltage, converted from NWB to EDF. It supports research on the fine-grained spatiotemporal neural dynamics of tone and speech processing.
methods_description: Intracranial ECoG was recorded during a speech perception task, with written informed consent obtained the day before surgery. The signal is the authors' 70-150 Hz Hilbert high-gamma envelope, originally stored in NWB and exported to EDF in uV. Round-trip conversion error is reported per file.
